title: MEIKO — Teach Us, Ms. Shiho!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay, so far so good...
For the last point, focus on the tip of your brush and gently lean it forward.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
...!
I-It worked...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Whoa! That's amazing, Miku-P!
It looks so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That last part was so intense. I could feel your concentration from over here, Miku...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I even held my breath there for a second...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It just means she was that focused.
So, Miku, how do you feel about this one?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I think it's my best work yet.
Thank you for giving me those tips, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. Hearing you say that makes it all worth it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: MEIKO! Me next! I want you to teach me! I've been practicing a bunch, but I still can't get it right...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Alright, sit here then.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think it'll turn out better if you improve your posture, Rin. Open up about a fist between you and the desk...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You really are amazing, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, it's like you've already become our second teacher.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She is the best calligrapher out of all of us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, you think so?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Even though you struggled just as much when we started working on our New Year's resolutions...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you practice in secret or something?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, you could say that...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for giving me another lesson today, Shiho. I think I have a better idea of what to do now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm glad to hear that.
How are the others doing...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
They've been improving at a steady rate.
We also have you to thank for that, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, I didn't do anything special...
You're all improving because you're putting in the effort.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. I should give this to you before I forget.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Please feel free to use it if you like.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, a notebook...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, it contains a list of tips and tricks that I thought would help. Maybe you and the others can use it for reference.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Wow, this is incredible...!
It talks about maintaining a good posture, how to hold your brush... And it's all so beautifully written.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Everything in this notebook... It must've taken you a very long time to write it all down.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It wasn't any trouble. It just doesn't feel right to me to not give the commitments I've made the effort they deserve.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, seeing you and the others work so hard to improve made me want to give the best advice I could.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. Then, we promise to cherish this gift.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (It's so like Shiho to do this.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll be going now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you again for this notebook, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, this really is written up so clearly...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (This notebook is sure to help us improve.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (We'll need to do our best to make the most of the gift Shiho's given us.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now then... I'll put this notebook to use right away!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, I got the flick wrong again.
It needs to look more like a clean triangle...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This situation calls for...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, this page!
Let's see... “Before you flick, bring your brush to a halt and...”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm struggling to keep these lines straight. But I'm being so careful...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm pretty sure Shiho also mentioned something about this in her notebook...
What do we have here... “Straight lines require momentum”?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Momentum? I'm good at creating that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, I'll try giving it a little extra push...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I'm still nowhere near as good as Shiho...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But I'm able to teach the others now when Shiho isn't here... I suppose that's all my training paying off.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO, would you mind teaching me next after Rin's had her turn? My left-hand radicals are throwing everything off balance because they're turning out so big.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Then, can I go after her?
Something about my stopping points doesn't look right.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'll go around in order, so just sit tight.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'll keep practicing while going through Shiho's notebook again...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO, can I see it once you're done? There's something I'd like to check.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Shiho's notebook is helping everyone improve at a dramatic rate...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (That means we'll need to make our New Year's resolutions look absolutely spectacular!)
